quarterly_data.quarter: Illumina press release: Illumina releases SpliceAI2 to help advance rare disease (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Illumina introduced SpliceAI2, a new genomic AI model for identifying disease-relevant splice variants, which customers can access through its BioInsight applications, including DRAGEN Annotation and Emedgene. In a preprint from Illumina's BioInsight AI Lab, SpliceAI2 identified 17% more disease-relevant splice variants than other models in analyses of Genomics England cohorts, and improved quantification of splice site usage by 34% compared to the next best model on NIH Genotype-Tissue Expression Portal data; it was trained on a dataset 100 times larger than the original SpliceAI. Illumina says SpliceAI2, PromoterAI and PrimateAI-3D together enable researchers to identify up to twice as many variants with predicted biological impact; the first-generation SpliceAI has been cited in over 3,400 publications and is incorporated into ClinGen guidelines for splice variant interpretation.
quarterly_data.figure: 17% more disease-relevant splice variants; splice site usage quantification improved by 34%; trained on a dataset 100 times larger; first-generation SpliceAI cited in over 3,400 publications
